title: The finishing work
Glass and iron
summary: The master builder wants the finest work of {settlement} finished properly: {giver} needs glass and iron.
offer: Any fool can raise a wall. Finishing is what makes a building — glass in the windows, iron on the doors. Bring them, and I will show this town what a builder can do.
progress: Still short of the finishing stuff.
complete: Look at that. Come and see it lit tonight; you helped build it.
